tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Searches products, items for pickup, services and appointments sold by every shop on nordo. With shop, the same search and filters as that shop's page. Returns one page of matching offers with price, facts (colour, size, material…), choices, the shop's own photo and, for each option that fits the fi

tools.name: list_shops
tools.description: Lists shops on nordo with what they sell (categories, number of offers) and where they ship. Optional words narrow it by name or category.

tools.name: get_shop
tools.description: A shop's facts (address, contact, whether it is open for pickup and the next pickup times, shipping regions, delivery time, shipping cost, returns, booking hours, what nordo has verified), its tables and other bookings first (reservations: party sizes, next free times with booking links, how to book

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: One offer in full: description, photos, every option with its price, stock and order link, its choices (option_groups such as sides or a drink: keys, how many to pick, extra prices, availability), pickup facts for pickup items, and for an appointment, class or table the next free times with booking

tools.name: get_free_times
tools.description: Every free time of an appointment, class or restaurant table for the next four weeks (or one day), in the shop's time zone, each with its booking link. A table lists only the times with room for the party in guests (2 by default), and each booking link books that many guests; a class lists its place

tools.name: prepare_order
tools.description: Prepares an order for the person at the live price (for an appointment, holds the time for 15 minutes) and returns a payment link (pay_url) to give them. The person opens it to review and pay with Apple Pay, Google Pay or card, or, at a shop that takes cash on delivery (get_shop), to pay on delivery

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Where a prepared order is: waiting_for_payment, authorized (paid with the amount held until the shop accepts), accepted, paid, ready (for pickup), picked_up, shipped, confirmed (appointment), completed, no_show (the shop marked that nobody came to a free booking), cancelled, declined (nothing charge
